lines.en: Can I get you anything, huh? Lens cleaner?
Thank God you're here. You have to help me.
Were you just talking to yourself?
That's less embarrassing. Yes, yes I was.
When she came in, I got distracted and totally forgot about the camera.
It kept rolling and recorded everything.
Yeah, we're gonna need to see that tape.
What a great idea. That'll get Rachel to forgive me.
You know what? This is not fair to her. Let's just forget the tape.
